items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: T Hound Slim, that's the first. T Hound Slim? Yeah, he used to dance and singing. Dance in front of the band.

ctx.x: Well, the first big band came to New Orleans. I know it was the first one. It was in the, in the, in the, in the, in the, in the early 30's. George E. Lee from Kansas City. Oh yeah? Was that a good band? Ooh, yes indeed. That's the first time I ever heard big time music. Mmhmm. And then, Belton. From Florida.
Belton? That's entirely new to me. I never heard of him before in my life. Belton. Belton. Featuring T Hound Slim.

That's the second big band invented here. T what? T Hound Slim, that's the first. T Hound Slim? Yeah, he used to dance and singing. Dance in front of the band. That's all, let's dance. Mmhmm. Then I forgot about Walter Barnes. Mmhmm. He was coming in. Then, uh, Nat Tolles started coming. Mmhmm. Nat Tolles.
